name: Workflow C - Safe User Notification via Amazon SES

parameters.query:
SELECT 
  u.id AS user_id,
  u.external_user_id,
  u.name AS user_name,
  u.email AS original_sample_email,
  COUNT(m.id) AS matched_count,
  json_agg(json_build_object(
    'product_name', p.product_name,
    'source_name', p.source_name,
    'source_url', p.source_url,
    'rate_min', p.interest_rate_min,
    'rate_max', p.interest_rate_max,
    'reasons', m.match_reasons
  )) AS matched_products
FROM users u
JOIN matches m ON m.user_id = u.id
JOIN loan_products p ON p.id = m.product_id
WHERE m.import_id = $1::uuid
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM notifications n 
    WHERE n.import_id = m.import_id 
      AND n.user_id = u.id 
      AND n.status = 'SENT'
  )
GROUP BY u.id, u.external_user_id, u.name, u.email;
